title: Step 1 · Quality event · raised to closed · 20.5 s
sub: NC-204 on one record: it lands with its evidence, owners contain it in the thread, engineering finds the cause, the owner decides and signs under Part 11, and it can only close complete.

beats.head: Raised (the poster)
beats.text: M. Osei raises NC-204 from the in-process check on WO-8817. Open, 0 of 7, and Close event is locked.

beats.head: The report lands
beats.text: Coating reads 38.1 µm, spec is 45 to 55. Photos and thickness readings are attached to the record.

beats.head: Evidence ticks itself
beats.text: Photos and readings from the line, part and work order from ERP. Nothing re-keyed. 2 of 7.

beats.head: The owner asks in the thread
beats.text: J. Rivera @mentions M. Osei to quarantine lot 118-B and M. Kerr to sort the WIP.

beats.head: Her ask lands
beats.text: 08:02, on the record's own thread, next to the evidence.

beats.head: Contained from the line
beats.text: M. Osei confirms 240 units held; her tick lands live on Quarantine lot 118-B. The event moves to In progress.

beats.head: WIP sorted
beats.text: M. Kerr ticks Sort remaining WIP live at 08:09. 4 of 7.

beats.head: Root cause, next working day
beats.text: Mon, Sep 28: S. Okafor posts the worn fixture on head 2 with photos; Root cause ticks live. 5 of 7.

beats.head: The owner decides
beats.text: J. Rivera opens Disposition: Rework to spec, Use as is, or Scrap.

beats.head: Rework to spec
beats.text: Chosen and ticked at 11:02. 6 of 7.

beats.head: Sign, on the checklist
beats.text: J. Rivera hovers and presses Sign on Quality approval, as on the platform film.

beats.head: The Part 11 dialog
beats.text: Meaning of signature: Approval, Review or Responsibility. She picks Approval, I approve this disposition.

beats.head: Her credentials
beats.text: User ID jrivera, password typed. Signed under 21 CFR Part 11; name, meaning and time kept on the record.

beats.head: Signing
beats.text: Sign waits for both, then signs.

beats.head: Signed
beats.text: The button turns to Signed before the dialog closes.

beats.head: Sealed on both sides
beats.text: Signed on Quality approval (Approval · 11:20) and her signature card in the thread. 7 of 7.

beats.head: Close unlocks
beats.text: Only now, with every item and the signature on the record, does Close event unlock.

beats.head: She closes it
beats.text: Hover, press, Closing.

beats.head: Closed, and the record says why
beats.text: Status Closed. The thread notes NC-204 closed by J. Rivera, every item and signature on the record.

beats.head: End at rest
beats.text: The finished record. The page holds this 1.5 s, then the next tab starts.
